hero.title: Skiper blocks low-value recommendations before they steal your time.
hero.subtitle: Skiper reads the spoken content of recommended videos, scores quality and personal relevance with your own preference prompt, then masks weak recommendations while keeping everything clickable.

highlights.title: Transcript-first filtering
highlights.body: Each suggested video is identified by URL/ID, transcript text is fetched, and only then scored with the model configured in your backend.

highlights.title: Personal relevance engine
highlights.body: Your custom prompt is always included in scoring. Relevance is measured against what is actually useful for your goals.

highlights.title: Live preference evolution
highlights.body: Use the Feedback button on the current video: your comment and transcript update your personal prompt, so the feed learns your standards.

install.title: How to install and run Skiper
install.subtitle: Full setup in a few minutes. This build is distributed as a ZIP because it is not yet in the Chrome Web Store.

steps.title: Download the extension ZIP
steps.body: Click "Download Extension" above and save the archive to your machine.

steps.title: Unpack the archive
steps.body: Extract the ZIP into any folder, for example `~/Downloads/skiper-extension`.

steps.title: Load it in Chrome
steps.body: Open `chrome://extensions`, enable Developer Mode, click Load unpacked, and choose the extracted folder.

steps.title: Set your relevance prompt
steps.body: Open Skiper from the toolbar and write what content is useful for you (topics, depth, style, what to avoid).

steps.title: Use YouTube normally
steps.body: Open Home, Subscriptions, or any watch page. Skiper will score recommendations and hide videos with score below 5.

steps.title: Train with feedback
steps.body: On any watched video click Feedback near the title, explain what was good/bad, and Skiper updates your prompt automatically.
